fairUse.rationale: Reduced original cover illustration from its artist's portfolio, used to identify the cited 2016 Purple Brain edition in an independent first-player-rule reference; it does not substitute for the game or artwork.
fairUse.provenance: Official Thibault Prugne, original illustrator source page: https://thibaultprugne.com/portfolio/le-tour-du-monde-en-80-jours/. Edition match: The illustrator's portfolio explicitly identifies this as the 2016 Purple Brain game Le tour du monde en 80 jours, the original title of the approved English Around the World in 80 Days record. Original image URL: https://thibaultprugne.com/wp-content/uploads/couvnew.jpg. Processing note: Original cover painting without added box typography, displayed as an artist-sourced illustration rather than a photograph of the English box.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited London starts; alternatively, choose one player randomly using everyone’s Hat pawn.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns proceed clockwise.
This is the 2016 Purple Brain Creations game with Rumor cards and Travel Journals.

sources.title: Around the World in 80 Days — English rulebook
